ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the MPCIP product record was ingested by the collector

reportName.description: Name of the source report file the record was extracted from

reportFolder.description: Folder or interface path from which the source report was collected

product_id.description: Product identifier from the Id field of the source OData node

product_name.description: Product name from the Name field of the source OData node

content_length.description: Product content size in bytes from the ContentLength field of the source OData node

publication_date.description: Product publication date from the PublicationDate field of the source OData node

start_date.description: Product content start date from the ContentDate.Start field of the source OData node

end_date.description: Product content end date from the ContentDate.End field of the source OData node

interface_name.description: Collector interface name set to MPCIP_Acri

production_service_type.description: Production service type set by the collector to MPCIP

production_service_name.description: Production service name set by the collector to Acri

eviction_date.description: Product eviction date from the EvictionDate field of the source OData node

origin_date.description: Product origin date from the OriginDate field of the source OData node

footprint.description: Geographic footprint of the product as a WKT/GeoJSON geometry string
